title: When Text-to-Image Helps Editing: The Effects of Conditioning During Denoising
title_zh: 当文本到图像助力编辑：去噪过程中条件作用的影响

paragraphs.en: Unified models are trained for both instruction-based image editing and text-to-image (T2I) generation, but standard editing pipelines keep source-image conditioning throughout denoising. We ask whether editing can benefit from T2I, and study how the effects of conditioning vary across edits and denoising stages. In pure editing, source attention declines for some edits over the sampling trajectory. This observation led us to task switching, which lets the model draw on its T2I capabilities. Across three unified editors and four benchmarks, switching to the T2I task for bounded intervals improves edit quality, while mean perceptual preservation remains close to pure editing across all three models. Unified editors therefore benefit from using both conditioning modes they are trained for, and the timing of the switch sets the balance between quality and preservation.
paragraphs.zh: 统一模型同时用于指令式图像编辑和文本到图像（T2I）生成训练，但标准的编辑流程在整个去噪过程中都会保留源图像的约束条件。 我们探讨了编辑过程能否从 T2I 中受益，并研究了约束条件在不同编辑和去噪阶段所产生的效果差异。 在纯编辑任务中，某些编辑操作在采样过程中源图像注意力会逐渐减弱。 这一观察结果促使我们引入任务切换机制，使模型能够利用其 T2I 能力。 在三款统一编辑器及四个基准测试中，将模型切换到 T2I 任务一段时间内可以提升编辑质量，同时所有三款模型的平均感知保留率与纯编辑方式相近。 因此，统一编辑器通过结合使用两种训练时所支持的约束模式而受益，而切换时机则决定了质量与内容保留之间的平衡。

paragraphs.en: Unified multimodal models support text-to-image (T2I) generation and instruction-based image editing with the same architecture and weights ( Black Forest Labs, 2025 ; Deng et al., 2025 ) . T2I generation synthesizes an image from a caption describing the desired scene ( Rombach et al., 2022 ) , while editing transforms a source image according to a natural-language instruction ( Brooks et al., 2023 ) . Within a unified model, the two tasks offer a synergy between synthesizing a coherent target scene and retaining relevant content from an existing image.
paragraphs.zh: 统一的多模态模型能够使用相同的架构和权重支持文本到图像（T2I）生成以及基于指令的图像编辑（Black Forest Labs, 2025；Deng et al., 2025）。 T2I 生成通过根据对目标场景的描述性文本合成图像（Rombach et al., 2022），而图像编辑则根据自然语言指令对源图像进行转换（Brooks et al., 2023）。 在统一模型中，这两项任务实现了合成连贯的目标场景与保留现有图像中相关内容之间的协同作用。

sents.en: Unified multimodal models support text-to-image (T2I) generation and instruction-based image editing with the same architecture and weights ( Black Forest Labs, 2025 ; Deng et al., 2025 ) .
sents.zh: 统一的多模态模型能够使用相同的架构和权重支持文本到图像（T2I）生成以及基于指令的图像编辑（Black Forest Labs, 2025；Deng et al., 2025）。

paragraphs.en: Standard pipelines nevertheless use these capabilities separately. In diffusion editors such as FLUX2-Klein ( Black Forest Labs, 2025 ) , editing conditions on the source image and instruction throughout denoising, while T2I generation uses a caption alone. Source-image conditioning therefore stays fixed over the course of an edit, and the model’s dual capability goes unused within a single trajectory.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，标准流程仍然将这些能力分开使用。 在 FLUX2-Klein（Black Forest Labs，2025）等扩散编辑器中，编辑条件会作用于源图像并在整个去噪过程中结合指令使用，而 T2I 生成则仅使用图像说明。 因此，在编辑过程中，源图像的调节条件始终保持不变，模型的双重能力在单个轨迹中并未得到利用。

sents.en: Standard pipelines nevertheless use these capabilities separately.
sents.zh: 然而，标准流程仍然将这些能力分开使用。

sents.en: In diffusion editors such as FLUX2-Klein ( Black Forest Labs, 2025 ) , editing conditions on the source image and instruction throughout denoising, while T2I generation uses a caption alone.
sents.zh: 在 FLUX2-Klein（Black Forest Labs，2025）等扩散编辑器中，编辑条件会作用于源图像并在整个去噪过程中结合指令使用，而 T2I 生成则仅使用图像说明。

sents.en: Source-image conditioning therefore stays fixed over the course of an edit, and the model’s dual capability goes unused within a single trajectory.
sents.zh: 因此，在编辑过程中，源图像的调节条件始终保持不变，模型的双重能力在单个轨迹中并未得到利用。

paragraphs.en: Persistent source-image anchoring preserves structure, but it can also suppress intended changes ( Hertz et al., 2022 ; Zhou et al., 2025 ) . When the target scene diverges substantially from the input, editors can under-execute the instruction or integrate the change poorly, with visible seams and mismatched lighting. This raises a question: does every edit benefit from source-image conditioning at every stage of denoising?
paragraphs.zh: 持续性的源图像锚定能够保留结构，但也可能抑制预期的改动（Hertz 等，2022；Zhou 等，2025）。 当目标场景与输入图像存在显著差异时，编辑者可能会执行指令不足，或未能妥善融合改动，导致出现明显的接缝和光照不匹配。 这引出了一个问题：在去噪的每个阶段，每次编辑都是否都受益于源图像的约束条件？

sents.en: Persistent source-image anchoring preserves structure, but it can also suppress intended changes ( Hertz et al., 2022 ; Zhou et al., 2025 ) .
sents.zh: 持续性的源图像锚定能够保留结构，但也可能抑制预期的改动（Hertz 等，2022；Zhou 等，2025）。

sents.en: When the target scene diverges substantially from the input, editors can under-execute the instruction or integrate the change poorly, with visible seams and mismatched lighting.
sents.zh: 当目标场景与输入图像存在显著差异时，编辑者可能会执行指令不足，或未能妥善融合改动，导致出现明显的接缝和光照不匹配。

sents.en: This raises a question: does every edit benefit from source-image conditioning at every stage of denoising?
sents.zh: 这引出了一个问题：在去噪的每个阶段，每次编辑都是否都受益于源图像的约束条件？

paragraphs.en: To answer it, we examine source-image attention in pure-editing trajectories. With source conditioning available throughout denoising, some edits progressively attend less to it, while localized changes retain strong source attention through the final steps ( Section 3.1 ). This led us to test whether temporarily removing source conditioning can improve edit fidelity and naturalness.
paragraphs.zh: 为了回答这个问题，我们研究了纯编辑轨迹中的源图像注意力机制。 在整个去噪过程中都具备源条件信息的情况下，某些编辑会逐渐减少对源图像的注意力，而局部变化则会在最后几步中保持对源图像的强注意力（第 3.1 节）。 这促使我们测试：暂时移除源条件信息是否能够提升编辑的保真度和自然度。

sents.en: To answer it, we examine source-image attention in pure-editing trajectories.
sents.zh: 为了回答这个问题，我们研究了纯编辑轨迹中的源图像注意力机制。

sents.en: With source conditioning available throughout denoising, some edits progressively attend less to it, while localized changes retain strong source attention through the final steps ( Section 3.1 ).
sents.zh: 在整个去噪过程中都具备源条件信息的情况下，某些编辑会逐渐减少对源图像的注意力，而局部变化则会在最后几步中保持对源图像的强注意力（第 3.1 节）。

sents.en: This led us to test whether temporarily removing source conditioning can improve edit fidelity and naturalness.
sents.zh: 这促使我们测试：暂时移除源条件信息是否能够提升编辑的保真度和自然度。

paragraphs.en: For a fixed interval, we remove source-image conditioning and replace the editing instruction with a target caption generated by a vision-language model (VLM). We then restore the original editing inputs. The model weights and number of denoiser forward passes remain unchanged. Figure 1 shows an example: switching to T2I helps integrate the added objects into the scene, and returning to editing preserves more of the original room.
paragraphs.zh: 在固定时间间隔内，我们移除源图像条件约束，并将编辑指令替换为视觉语言模型（VLM）生成的目标描述。 随后，我们恢复原始的编辑输入。 模型权重和去噪器前向传播次数保持不变。 图1展示了一个示例：切换到 T2I 有助于将新增物体融入场景，而返回编辑模式则能保留更多原始房间的细节。

sents.en: For a fixed interval, we remove source-image conditioning and replace the editing instruction with a target caption generated by a vision-language model (VLM).
sents.zh: 在固定时间间隔内，我们移除源图像条件约束，并将编辑指令替换为视觉语言模型（VLM）生成的目标描述。

sents.en: We then restore the original editing inputs.
sents.zh: 随后，我们恢复原始的编辑输入。

sents.en: The model weights and number of denoiser forward passes remain unchanged.
sents.zh: 模型权重和去噪器前向传播次数保持不变。

sents.en: Figure 1 shows an example: switching to T2I helps integrate the added objects into the scene, and returning to editing preserves more of the original room.
sents.zh: 图1展示了一个示例：切换到 T2I 有助于将新增物体融入场景，而返回编辑模式则能保留更多原始房间的细节。

paragraphs.en: We find that the strength of source-image attention depends on the type of edit and varies over the course of denoising. This suggests that for some classes of edits, source conditioning is redundant at certain stages.
paragraphs.zh: 我们发现，源图像注意力的强度取决于编辑类型，并会在去噪过程中发生变化。 这表明，对于某些类型的编辑，在特定阶段，源条件信息是多余的。

sents.en: We find that the strength of source-image attention depends on the type of edit and varies over the course of denoising.
sents.zh: 我们发现，源图像注意力的强度取决于编辑类型，并会在去噪过程中发生变化。

sents.en: This suggests that for some classes of edits, source conditioning is redundant at certain stages.
sents.zh: 这表明，对于某些类型的编辑，在特定阶段，源条件信息是多余的。

paragraphs.en: We identify a conditioning regime that consistently improves edit quality across three models and four benchmarks while keeping preservation virtually the same.
paragraphs.zh: 我们发现了一种条件设置方案，该方案在三种模型和四个基准测试中持续提升了编辑质量，同时几乎未改变保留率。

paragraphs.en: We vary the degrees of freedom of this regime, the conditioning inputs, the interval placement and duration, and the guidance formulation, and characterize how each affects edit quality and preservation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们调整了该机制的自由度、条件输入、时间间隔的位置和持续时间，以及引导公式，并描述了这些因素各自如何影响编辑质量和内容保留。

paragraphs.en: Prompt-to-Prompt reuses cross-attention maps over text tokens from a source generation and limits their injection in time to permit structural changes ( Hertz et al., 2022 ) . SaaS identifies source-image dominance over neglected instructions in OmniGen and adaptively scales instruction attention. In its examples, jointly replacing image and text inputs late in denoising has little effect ( Zhou et al., 2025 ) . GRAG modulates the relative influence of source-image and instruction tokens to control editing intensity ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) . We ask the same question about source conditioning, but instead of rescaling attention we change the conditioning inputs themselves and measure the outcome, using attention maps only as a diagnostic.
paragraphs.zh: Prompt-to-Prompt 方法会重复利用源生成过程中文本标记的交叉注意力图，并限制其在时间上的注入，以实现结构变化（Hertz 等，2022）。 SaaS 方法识别出 OmniGen 中源图像相对于被忽视指令的主导性，并自适应地调整指令注意力。 在其示例中，在去噪后期同时替换图像和文本输入几乎不会产生效果（Zhou 等，2025）。 GRAG 方法调节源图像和指令标记的相对影响，以控制编辑强度（Zhang 等，2025）。 我们对源条件化提出了同样的问题，但不同于重新缩放注意力，我们改变的是条件化输入本身，并测量其结果，仅将注意力图用作诊断工具。

sents.zh: 在其示例中，在去噪后期同时替换图像和文本输入几乎不会产生效果（Zhou 等，2025）。

paragraphs.en: eDiff-I observes that reliance on text conditioning decreases during sampling and trains separate denoisers for different noise levels ( Balaji et al., 2022 ) . Restricting classifier-free guidance to a limited interval also improves generation ( Kynkäänniemi et al., 2024 ) . PCI intervenes on the text prompt during T2I sampling to find when a concept can still be inserted. The resulting temporal profiles differ across concepts and models and carry over to editing ( Görgün et al., 2026 ) . We extend this line of work from varying denoisers, guidance, or text prompts across denoising stages to switching between image-conditioned editing and caption-only generation within a unified model.
paragraphs.zh: eDiff-I 观察到，在采样过程中对文本条件的依赖会减弱，并针对不同的噪声水平训练了独立的去噪器（Balaji 等人，2022）。 将无分类器引导限制在有限区间内也能提升生成效果（Kynkäänniemi 等人，2024）。 PCI 在 T2I 采样过程中对文本提示进行干预，以确定某个概念仍能被插入的时间点。 由此产生的时间分布特征因概念和模型而异，并会延续到编辑过程中（Görgün 等人，2026）。 我们将这一研究方向从在不同去噪阶段使用不同的去噪器、引导机制或文本提示，扩展到了在统一模型内部切换图像条件编辑与仅使用标题的生成模式。

sents.zh: 由此产生的时间分布特征因概念和模型而异，并会延续到编辑过程中（Görgün 等人，2026）。

paragraphs.en: HiDream-E1’s released pipeline provides a direct precedent for an editing-to-generation handoff: it continues the same latent with a target caption, removes source-image conditioning, and finishes the remaining steps with the HiDream-I1 generator weights ( HiDream-ai, 2025 ) . For refinement of generated images, RvR argues that pixel-level preservation restricts the space of possible changes, and trains a regeneration model conditioned on target prompts and semantic image tokens without source VAE tokens ( Guo et al., 2026 ) . Building on these pipelines, we study how source-image conditioning, the text paired with it, and interval timing affect edit quality and source preservation across unified editors. Conditioning controls and timing sweeps use the models’ native editing and T2I modes within one denoising trajectory under unchanged weights.
paragraphs.zh: HiDream-E1 发布的流程为“编辑到生成”的交接提供了直接先例：它使用相同的潜在表示和目标说明继续处理，移除源图像条件输入，然后用 HiDream-I1 生成器权重完成剩余步骤（HiDream-ai, 2025）。 在生成图像的优化方面，RvR 认为像素级保留会限制可能的变化空间，因此训练了一个再生模型，该模型以目标提示和语义图像标记为条件，而不包含源 VAE 标记（Guo et al., 2026）。 基于这些流程，我们研究了源图像条件输入、与之配对的文本以及时间间隔如何影响统一编辑器中的编辑质量和源图像保留效果。 条件控制和时间间隔扫描在权重不变的情况下，于单一去噪轨迹内使用模型的原生编辑和 T2I 模式。

paragraphs.en: A unified model is trained for two tasks but runs one at a time. Every editing request has a source image, and the pipeline conditions on it at every step regardless of what the request asks for. Editing requests, however, differ widely in nature and in difficulty: enhancing the lighting adjusts an intact scene, whereas replacing a background asks the model to synthesize most of the image from scratch. It would be surprising if one conditioning policy served both equally well. This section examines how an editor actually uses the source image across such edits and across denoising steps.

paragraphs.en: To test whether the effect is a property of unified editors rather than of one model, we evaluate three that differ in size, architecture, and training: FLUX2-Klein 4B and 9B ( Black Forest Labs, 2025 ) , two sizes of one diffusion-transformer family, and BAGEL ( Deng et al., 2025 ) , a separately developed model. The benchmarks cover complementary aspects of editing quality. GEdit-Bench ( Liu et al., 2025 ) uses real user instructions across task types and scores semantic consistency and perceptual quality separately. ImgEdit ( Ye et al., 2025 ) adds hard categories such as extraction, composition, and actions. MagicBrush ( Zhang et al., 2023 ) supplies a reference caption for every target, which allows a judge-free alignment score. GIE-Bench ( Qian et al., 2025 ) scores functional correctness and preservation separately, so quality gains can be priced in preservation.
paragraphs.zh: 为了测试这种效果是统一编辑器的特性而非单个模型的特性，我们评估了三种在规模、架构和训练方面各不相同的模型：FLUX2-Klein 4B 和 9B（Black Forest Labs, 2025），它们是同一扩散-变换器家族的两个版本，以及 BAGEL（Deng et al., 2025），一个独立开发的模型。 这些基准测试涵盖了编辑质量的不同互补方面。 GEdit-Bench（Liu et al., 2025）使用不同任务类型的真实用户指令，并分别对语义一致性和感知质量进行评分。 ImgEdit（Ye et al., 2025）增加了更难的任务类别，例如提取、构图和操作。 MagicBrush（Zhang et al., 2023）为每个目标提供参考说明，这使得无需人工评判即可计算对齐分数。 GIE-Bench（Qian et al., 2025）分别对功能正确性和内容保留进行评分，因此质量提升可以转化为内容保留的衡量标准。

paragraphs.en: Trading preservation for quality is easy: any editor can be pushed toward the target by loosening its anchor to the source. Improving quality without giving up preservation is the hard part, and this is what a T2I interval achieves. Our sweeps over interval length and position identify [ 10 , 16 ) [10,16) as a strong fixed interval: applied to every edit, it raises all six quality scores on all three models ( Table 2 ), while preservation as judged by GPT-4.1 stays within a fraction of a point of pure editing. The pixel-level measures, SSIM and Unmasked-CLIP, do drop, and Section 4.4 examines how much of that drop is perceptible. The interval is not unique: several placements improve GEdit semantic consistency and perceptual quality at once ( Figure 4 ), and which one is best depends on the model and the metric.
paragraphs.zh: 为了追求质量而牺牲保留性其实很容易：只要放松智能体对源文本的锚定，任何智能体都能被推向目标。 在不放弃保留性的前提下提升质量才是难题，而这正是 T2I 区间所实现的目标。 我们对区间长度和位置进行的扫描发现，[10, 16) 是一个表现优异的固定区间：将其应用于每次编辑后，三种模型的全部六个质量评分均有所提升（表 2），而由 GPT-4.1 评估的保留性仅与纯编辑结果相差零点几分。 SSIM 和 Unmasked-CLIP 这两个像素级指标确实有所下降，第 4.4 节将探讨这种下降在多大程度上是肉眼可见的。 这个区间并非唯一：多种位置设置能同时提升 GEdit 的语义一致性和感知质量（图 4），而哪种设置最佳则取决于具体模型和评估指标。

paragraphs.en: Figure 5 shows what the scores summarize: switching executes edits that pure editing leaves undone or half done, and returning to editing is what keeps the rest of the source intact, as the one-way column shows by contrast (more examples in Appendix A ).
paragraphs.zh: 图5展示了评分所总结的内容：切换执行了纯编辑未能完成或仅部分完成的修改，而返回编辑模式则使源文本的其余部分保持完整，这与单向列中的情况形成了鲜明对比（更多示例见附录A）。

paragraphs.en: Switching changes two things at once, the image input and the text, and the controls in Table 1 pull them apart; Table 8 summarizes the best scores for each conditioning schedule. Rewording alone does help: a VLM-improved instruction early in the trajectory reaches the highest GEdit overall score among the control winners ( Figure 7 , left). But the perceptual-quality gain is specific to removing the source image. With the same caption, comparing conditioning with and without the source image ( Figure 6 ) shows that removing the image allows larger gains in fidelity, naturalness, and artifact scores on every model. The text matters in two different ways. Removing the image while keeping only the editing instruction loses semantic consistency, because nothing tells the model what the scene should become. Pairing the caption with the source image also loses semantic consistency, whether the pair is used for the whole trajectory or only outside the interval; here the caption does describe the target, so the likely cause is that the editor was trained to combine the source image with an instruction, not with a description of the result. The improvement therefore comes from switching the task, source-free generation toward a described target, and not from either change alone.
paragraphs.zh: 切换会同时改变两个要素：图像输入和文本，而表 1 中的控制项会将它们分离；表 8 总结了每种条件安排的最佳得分。 仅重新表述确实有帮助：在轨迹早期使用 VLM 改进的指令，在控制组获胜者中获得了最高的整体 GEdit 得分（图 7，左侧）。 但感知质量的提升仅与移除源图像有关。 对于相同的标题，比较包含和不含源图像的条件设置（图 6）可以发现，移除图像后，所有模型在保真度、自然度和伪影得分上都能获得更大的提升。 文本以两种不同方式产生影响。 如果仅保留编辑指令而移除图像，就会失去语义一致性，因为没有任何信息告诉模型场景应该变成什么样子。 将标题与源图像配对也会导致语义一致性的丧失，无论该组合是用于整个轨迹还是仅用于区间之外的部分；在这种情况下，标题确实描述了目标，因此可能的原因是编辑器被训练来结合源图像和指令，而不是结合对结果的描述。 因此，这种改进源于任务的切换——即从无需源图像的生成转向生成一个有明确描述的目标——而非单独由其中任何一种变化引起。

paragraphs.en: The strongest single competitor is the improved instruction used for the whole trajectory, pure E ∗ , which costs the same one VLM call and the same two denoiser passes per step as switching ( Table 10 ). It is a strong baseline on the two FLUX models, where it wins GEdit semantic consistency and keeps SSIM higher. But on every model the best T2I interval beats it on GIE-Bench functional correctness, MagicBrush alignment, and GEdit perceptual quality, and the perceptual-quality margin is large. Where E ∗ wins semantic consistency, it does so through the preservation part of that score; fidelity is matched or exceeded by the T2I interval. On BAGEL, the improved instruction alone does not help at all, while the T2I interval improves every quality score. Better prompts make the editor follow the instruction more faithfully; only switching makes the result look better.

paragraphs.en: Continuous guidance provides a natural alternative to switching. Reducing image guidance over the same intervals barely changes GEdit overall and lowers ImgEdit, because image-conditioned predictions still drive the update even at zero guidance. Adding a caption-conditioned branch instead blends edit and T2I velocities at every step. At a quarter editing weight, this improves semantic consistency, correctness, and preservation over the pure E → T2I → E \mathrm{E}\to\mathrm{T2I}\to\mathrm{E} switch, but requires four denoiser passes per step rather than two ( Appendix C ). Switching is the endpoint of this family at the cost of pure editing and captures most of the benefit.
paragraphs.zh: 持续引导为切换提供了一种自然的替代方案。 在相同的时间间隔内减少图像引导几乎不会改变 GEdit 的整体表现，但会降低 ImgEdit，因为即使在引导为零时，基于图像的预测仍然会驱动更新。 相反，添加一个基于标题的条件分支会在每一步融合编辑和 T2I 的速度。 当编辑权重为四分之一时，这种方法在语义一致性、正确性和内容保留方面优于纯粹的 E → T2I → E \mathrm{E}\to\mathrm{T2I}\to\mathrm{E} 切换方式，但每一步需要四次去噪器处理，而不是两次（附录 C）。 切换是该方法家族在完全牺牲纯编辑效果的情况下所能达到的最终状态，但它也捕捉到了大部分优势。

paragraphs.en: Interval placement and duration are not independent knobs. Only short intervals in the early-middle of the trajectory land in the region that improves both scores, which is why [ 10 , 16 ) [10,16) is the featured setting. Beyond that region the choice is a trade: an editor that values naturalness should switch earlier or longer, one that values consistency later or shorter.
paragraphs.zh: 时间间隔的位置和持续时间并非相互独立的调节参数。 在所有四种持续时间中，扫描结果都描绘出同一条曲线（图7，右侧）：将时间间隔提前或延长会提升感知质量，但会牺牲语义一致性；随着时间间隔向轨迹末端滑动，所有曲线都会回到纯编辑点。 关键在于轨迹中有多少部分处于 T2I 阶段，以及这一阶段开始得有多早。 语义一致性的代价源于其“保留”部分；由于 SC 取每样本保真度与保留度的最小值，因此只要保留度进一步下降，保真度的提升就会被掩盖。 只有位于轨迹早期至中期、较短的时间间隔才会落入能同时提升两项评分的区域，这正是 [10, 16) 成为推荐设置的原因。 超出该区域后，选择便成为一种权衡：重视自然感的编辑者应更早切换或延长间隔，而重视一致性的编辑者则应更晚切换或缩短间隔。

Figure 8 (right) puts the two sides together: the featured intervals gain correctness at judged preservation indistinguishable from pure editing, while the early one-way switches that gain the most correctness are the ones that pay for it. paragraphs.en: The two metrics disagree because they measure different things. Figure 8 (left) shows how far the pixel drop overstates the cost: across the 4B sweep, judged preservation forms a plateau at the pure-editing level while SSIM varies, and declines only below it. paragraphs.en: Unified editors are trained for two tasks but use one at a time; this study puts the unused mode to work within an edit. An editor’s attention to the source image depends on what the edit needs from it and fades over denoising for edits that rebuild the scene, leaving a stretch of the trajectory where source conditioning constrains without contributing. Switching to the model’s own T2I mode on that stretch improves edit quality on every model and benchmark we tested, while an instruction-aware judge finds preservation essentially unchanged. The gain is a property of the switch rather than of the prompt: removing the source image is what unlocks perceptual quality, the caption is what keeps the scene on target, and continuous guidance reproduces the effect only at twice the cost. Placement and duration set where on the quality–preservation curve an editor lands, and the same attention signal that motivated the study can decide per edit whether to switch at all.

paragraphs.en: We use a simple switching schedule to establish that task switching can improve editing quality. More sophisticated switching and conditioning schemes may offer further gains. Our interval sweeps are coarse, so [ 10 , 16 ) [10,16) is one effective setting among those tested. paragraphs.en: To test whether the attention rule outperforms choosing edits at random, we replay per-sample GEdit scores (seed 1337 1337 ) under pure editing and under the fixed [ 10 , 16 ) [10,16) interval, and route each edit to one or the other. Table 15 reports the results for FLUX2-Klein 4B and 9B. On both models the rule exceeds the preservation-matched random baseline on overall, perceptual-quality, and fidelity scores, with the larger margin on 4B, where the thresholds were selected, and a smaller but same-signed margin on 9B, where they were transferred by distribution matching alone. BAGEL was not included in this replay.

paragraphs.en: We use GPT-4.1, the same judge as in our main GEdit evaluation, providing the source image, edited image, and editing instruction.
